join.condition: child.order_id = main.order_id AND child.parent_item_id = main.item_id AND main.product_type = 'configurable'

field.label: SKU
field.description: Simple SKU of the ordered item.

field.label: Parent SKU
field.description: SKU of the configurable parent, when the ordered item is a configurable child.

field.label: Unit cost
field.description: Base cost of one unit: the child (simple) row's cost when the parent row is a configurable, otherwise the row's own cost.

field.label: Has cost
field.description: Whether the resolved unit cost is known (not null).

field.label: Cost amount
field.description: Unit cost multiplied by units sold (ordered, net of cancellations and refunds).

field.label: Units ordered, net
field.description: Quantity ordered net of cancellations.

field.label: Units shipped
field.description: Quantity shipped.

field.label: Units to ship
field.description: Quantity ordered and not yet shipped, refunded or canceled; virtual items and bundles shipped separately excluded.

mysql.expression: (CASE WHEN main.is_virtual = 1 THEN 0 WHEN main.product_type = 'bundle' AND (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(main.product_options) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(main.product_options, '$.shipment_type')) END) = '1' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(main.qty_ordered, 0) - COALESCE(main.qty_shipped, 0) - COALESCE(main.qty_refunded, 0) - COALESCE(main.qty_canceled, 0), 0) END)

field.label: Gross sales amount
field.description: Row total, excluding tax, net of the canceled quantity.

field.label: Discount amount
field.description: Discount applied, net of the canceled quantity and of the discount tax compensation.

field.label: Returns amount
field.description: Amount refunded via credit memos, net of refunded discount.

field.label: Shipment count
field.description: Number of shipments containing the item (or its configurable child).

field.label: Credit memo count
field.description: Number of non-canceled credit memos containing the item (or its configurable child).

metric.label: Units sold
metric.description: Quantity ordered, net of cancellations.

metric.label: Units refunded
metric.description: Quantity refunded via credit memos. A lower value is an improvement.

metric.label: Units shipped
metric.description: Quantity shipped. Limitation: shipped units are attributed to the original order date, not the shipment date; bundle products shipped separately are not counted.

metric.label: Units to ship
metric.description: Quantity ordered and not yet shipped, refunded or canceled (virtual items and bundle products shipped separately excluded). A lower value is an improvement. Limitation: units are attributed to the original order date, so only orders placed in the selected period are included.

metric.label: Gross sales
metric.description: Row total, excluding tax. Configurable products are counted as a single line (bundle = single line).

metric.label: Discounts
metric.description: Discount amount applied to the item, net of the canceled quantity and of the discount tax compensation. A lower value is an improvement.

metric.label: Returns
metric.description: Amount refunded via credit memos, net of refunded discount. Limitation: returns are attributed to the original order date, not the credit memo date.

metric.label: Net sales
metric.description: Gross sales minus discounts minus returns.

metric.label: Cost
metric.description: Unit cost multiplied by units sold (net of canceled and refunded units), only over rows with a known cost.

metric.label: Gross margin
metric.description: Net sales minus cost.

metric.label: Margin %
metric.description: Gross margin as a percentage of net sales.

metric.label: Return rate
metric.description: Returns as a percentage of gross sales. A lower value is an improvement.

metric.label: Shipments
metric.description: Number of shipments containing the product. Limitation: shipments are attributed to the original order date, not the shipment date.

metric.label: Credit memos
metric.description: Number of credit memos containing the product, excluding canceled credit memos. A lower value is an improvement. Limitation: credit memos are attributed to the original order date, not the credit memo date.

metric.label: Orders
metric.description: Number of distinct orders contributing item rows.

metric.label: Rows with cost
metric.description: Helper metric for cost_coverage: number of item rows with a known unit cost.

metric.label: Rows
metric.description: Helper metric for cost_coverage: total number of item rows.

metric.label: Cost coverage
metric.description: Share of item rows with a known unit cost.

field.label: In stock
field.description: Whether the quantity on hand is greater than zero.

metric.label: Qty on hand
metric.description: Total quantity on hand across sources.

metric.label: Stock value (cost)
metric.description: Inventory value at cost.

metric.label: Stock value (retail)
metric.description: Inventory value at retail price.

metric.label: SKUs in stock
metric.description: Number of distinct SKUs with a quantity on hand greater than zero.

metric.label: Units sold (30 days)
metric.description: Units sold over the last 30 days.

metric.label: Avg daily sales
metric.description: Units sold over the last 30 days divided by 30.

metric.label: Coverage (days)
metric.description: Days the current stock lasts at the average daily sales; empty when there are no sales.

metric.label: Days since last sale
metric.description: Days since the last counted sale; empty when the product was never sold.

field.label: Has salable quantity
field.description: Whether the salable quantity is greater than zero.

metric.label: Stock quantity
metric.description: Quantity in the stock index, before pending reservations.

metric.label: Reserved quantity
metric.description: Quantity reserved by pending orders (positive when reserved).

metric.label: Salable quantity
metric.description: Quantity that can still be sold: stock quantity minus reservations and the minimum quantity.

metric.label: SKUs salable
metric.description: Number of distinct SKUs with a salable quantity greater than zero.

field.label: Last activity
field.description: When the cart was last updated.

field.label: Items count
field.description: Number of distinct items in the cart.

field.label: Items quantity
field.description: Total quantity of the items in the cart.

field.label: Cart value amount
field.description: Cart grand total in the base currency.

field.label: Cart subtotal amount
field.description: Cart subtotal in the base currency.

field.label: Customer email
field.description: Lowercased, trimmed cart email; guest carts without a quote email fall back to the billing address email.

field.label: Is guest
field.description: Whether the cart has no customer account.

field.label: Is converted
field.description: Whether an order was placed from the cart.

field.label: Is abandoned
field.description: Whether the cart is active, has items and an email (quote email, else billing address email), has no order, and was idle beyond the abandoned threshold.

field.label: Is recent
field.description: Whether the cart is active, has items, has no order and was updated within the recent cart hours.

field.label: Cart state
field.description: Lifecycle state of the cart: active, abandoned, abandoned without email, converted or inactive.

metric.label: Carts
metric.description: Number of carts with items. Limitation: carts are dated by their last activity (updated_at); a converted cart is dated near its order time.

metric.label: Cart value
metric.description: Sum of the cart grand totals.

metric.label: Average cart value
metric.description: Cart value divided by the number of carts.

metric.label: Items in carts
metric.description: Total quantity of the items in the carts.

metric.label: Abandoned carts
metric.description: Number of active carts with items and an email that were idle beyond the abandoned threshold. A lower value is an improvement.

metric.label: Abandoned value
metric.description: Cart value of the abandoned carts. A lower value is an improvement.

metric.label: Recent carts
metric.description: Number of active carts with items updated within the recent cart hours.

metric.label: Converted carts
metric.description: Number of carts from which an order was placed. Limitation: carts are dated by their last activity (updated_at); a converted cart is dated near its order time.

metric.label: Converted value
metric.description: Cart value of the converted carts.

metric.label: Abandonment rate
metric.description: Abandoned carts as a percentage of abandoned and converted carts. A lower value is an improvement. Limitation: carts are dated by their last activity (updated_at); a converted cart is dated near its order time.

metric.label: Conversion rate
metric.description: Converted carts as a percentage of all carts. Limitation: carts are dated by their last activity (updated_at); a converted cart is dated near its order time.

field.label: Cart items count

metric.description: Quantity of the products in the carts. Configurable products are counted on the parent line (the simple child is ignored); bundle = single line. Limitation: items are dated by the last activity of their cart (updated_at).

metric.label: Cart items value

metric.label: Carts

metric.label: Abandoned units

metric.label: Abandoned items value
metric.description: Row total of the items in abandoned carts. A lower value is an improvement.

metric.label: Abandoned carts
metric.description: Number of distinct abandoned carts containing the items. A lower value is an improvement.

metric.label: Converted units
metric.description: Quantity of the products in carts from which an order was placed.

metric.label: Item conversion rate
